transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we discussed, we're planning to launch the student peer-mediation program for the spring semester, and I need to hear each of your reports on the checklist items before I can give final approval to the operating plan. Let's go through this systematically. Who would like to start with their report?

transcript.text: I need to report on the roster and training status as required by the checklist. transcript.text: I need to report on the referral-screening requirements as required by the checklist. My current student-services file review has identified active no-contact orders involving two students, Nia and Omar. Any peer-mediation referrals involving either of these students must be screened out of the program. I confirmed these no-contact orders with the families this week, but I have not yet added the screening requirement to the current draft of the operating plan, so it needs to be incorporated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report on the safety and supervision requirements as required by the checklist. My safety review, which I finalized yesterday, finds that student mediators may handle only minor peer conflicts — they may not handle threats or moderate conflicts. Additionally, the approved operating protocol must assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session. I have not yet attached this review to the launch proposal, so these requirements need to be incorporated into the operating plan before approval. This is particularly important given that the current draft proposes only one adult supervisor and allows referrals for moderate conflicts, both of which would need to change.
